from pathlib import Path
import hashlib, importlib
expected=(Path.cwd() / 'src/jinja2/runtime.py').resolve()
module = importlib.import_module('jinja2.runtime')
actual=Path(module.__file__).resolve()
print("source_binding", str(actual), "sha256", hashlib.sha256(actual.read_bytes()).hexdigest())
assert actual == expected, (actual, expected)
import copy, pickle
from jinja2 import Undefined
u = Undefined(hint='h', obj=['foo'], name='n', exc=RuntimeError('e'))
c = copy.copy(u)
print('copy_identity', c is u)
assert c is not u, 'copy did not create a new object'
assert c._undefined_hint is u._undefined_hint
assert c._undefined_obj is u._undefined_obj
d = copy.deepcopy(u)
assert d is not u
print('deepcopy_obj_isolated', d._undefined_obj is not u._undefined_obj)
assert d._undefined_obj is not u._undefined_obj
assert d._undefined_obj == u._undefined_obj
p = pickle.loads(pickle.dumps(u))
assert p._undefined_hint == u._undefined_hint
print('f2_undefined_copy', True)
